name: Marconi Conference Center SHP
description: Marconi Conference Center State Historic Park is a 62-acre park above Tomales Bay near Marshall, known for its history and natural beauty. Its historic buildings are home to the Lodge at Marconi, which offers lodging and event space.
fullDescription: Marconi Conference Center State Historic Park is a 62-acre park above Tomales Bay near Marshall, known for its history and natural beauty. Its historic buildings are home to the Lodge at Marconi, which offers lodging and event space.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hiking trails, bird and wildlife watching, and Tomales Bay views
- Historic site open to the public from sunrise to sunset
- Overnight lodging and meeting and event space at the Lodge at Marconi (fees apply)
- No camping
howToGetIt: The park is open to the public from sunrise to sunset. No day-use fee is listed. For lodging or events at the Lodge at Marconi, call 415-663-9020.
keywords: Marconi Conference Center, state historic park, Marshall, Marin County, Tomales Bay, conference, retreats
